Name: Helez the Pelonite
Summary: Valient man of David's armies and captain of the seventh month's course.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:27; 1 Chronicles 27:10: Valient man of David's armies and captain of the seventh month's course.
LifeLesson: The mention of Helez in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
